postings.title: 2027 Internship (6 Months) - Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness, London
postings.description:
London – Data Science, Marketing Effectiveness 6 Month Internship
Job Description
Role: Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness
Start date: Jan - June 2027
Location: London, UK (Hybrid – Minimum 2 days in office per week)
About Ekimetrics         
 
Ekimetrics is a leader in data science and AI, specialising in marketing effectiveness and business optimisation since 2006. We help companies across various industries, including retail, automotive, banking, luxury fashion, and more, unlock the value of their data to drive sustainable business performance.
 
Our goal is to combine high-impact AI and data science solutions for sustainable business performance.
 
 We’re proud to be: 
DataIQ Best Company to Work For & Solution Provider 2025
·       UK Data Company of the Year 2023
·       Great Place to Work Certified 2023
·       Microsoft’s Sustainability Partner
·       Named a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Marketing Measurement 2023
 
With offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong and Shanghai, our 50+ data science consultants deliver over 1,000 high-impact projects each year for global clients.
 
About the Role
As a Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness Intern, you’ll spend 6 months in the Ekimetrics London team. You’ll work on global client projects to measure and optimise marketing performance through advanced analytics and statistical modelling.
 
You’ll gain first-hand experience as both a data scientist and strategic consultant, using tools like Python and econometric modelling to guide real-world business decisions.
 
You’ll collaborate on client projects and internal R&D from day one. Over the 6-month internship, you’ll also have the opportunity to complete a research project that aligns with your interests and contributes to our broader business goals.
 
Job Responsibilities
1. Data Analytics & Modelling
·       Analyse large data sets using statistical techniques to uncover key insights
·       Support the team in building marketing mix models (MMM), testing frameworks, forecasting tools, and customer segmentation
·       Use Python to process and clean data, write scripts and build ML or econometric models
·       Opportunity to work with tools like Power BI, Databricks, Git, Jira, Pandas, PySpark, VS Code
 
2. Consulting & Strategy
·       Gain experience translating complex data outputs into recommendations for clients
·       Attend internal and client meetings to understand real business challenges
·       Collaborate across teams to build deliverables, present findings and influence decisions
 
3. Eki Life & Learning
·       Undertake an individual R&D project based on your interests and present your findings to the Eki leadership team
·       Attend team events, internal training, knowledge sharing and social activities
·       Contribute to a fun, curious, and collaborative team culture
 
About You
Must Have 
·       Studying a quantitative degree (e.g. Economics, Maths, Engineering, Computer/Data Science, Statistics, etc.)
·       Strong interest in analytics, modelling, marketing strategy and customer analytics
·       Proficient in Excel functions (e.g., VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, TEXT, IF, SUMIFS, pivot tables) for data cleaning, validation, and structuring (this will be needed for the interview process) 
·       Some experience in Python, R or similar (academic, project or self-taught)
·       Solid foundation in statistics, econometrics and data manipulation
 
Consulting & Soft Skills:
·       Curious, detail-oriented and comfortable working with ambiguity
·       Excellent communication – both written and verbal
·       Highly collaborative, self-motivated and organised
·       A strong interest in working at the intersection of data and business
 
Must-Haves:
·       Available to work 5 days a week full-time
·       Full right to work in the UK for the duration of the placement. We cannot sponsor this role.
·       Enthusiastic about gaining experience in a hybrid data science/consulting role
 
Why Join Eki? 
·       £Competitve Salary Prorated + 20 days holiday + Bank holidays
·       Hybrid working (2 days a week in the office minimum)
·       Opportunity for full-time return offer (Junior Data Science Consultant starting salary of 40k!)
·       Training & mentorship from experienced consultants
·       Vibrant, international office culture (75+ employees in London office)
·       Regular socials, global knowledge sharing & learning sessions
·       A chance to work on real projects and make an impact from day one
 
 Our recruitment process
1.       Online Technical Test (HackerRank) – 45 mins
2.      Introductory Interview with a member of the talent acquisition team - 15-30 mins
3.      Case Study Interview 45mins – 1 hour
4.      Final Interview – 45 minutes
__________________________________________________________________________________________________________
 
Any questions, please contact recruitment.uk@ekimetrics.com
 
At Ekimetrics, we believe our best assets are our people - they are what set us apart and drive our success. We share what we know with others, and, above all, we love what we do. These sentiments are supported by our company values, which serve as pillars in our work and attitude.

Latent Reasoning for Tabular Foundation Models: Performance Enhancement and Interpretability 

Ekimetrics is the European leader in data science, with over 500 data scientists and 1,000+ projects since 2006. With offices in Paris, London, New York, and Hong Kong, we conduct projects in over 50 countries across various sectors, including financial services, retail, telecom, healthcare, and more. 

Our mission is to help companies audit their data opportunities, enhance their analytical capital, and deploy actionable solutions that maximize their marketing and operational performance while reinvigorating business models. 

Our absolute focus is on delivering short-term gains while ensuring the long-term development of our clients' data capital. We are committed to offering the most advanced data science approaches and building ethical, sustainable AI practices. 

Key Figures 

- 

20 years of experience in data science 

- 

500+ data scientists, all consultants 

- 

5 offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong, and Shanghai 

- 

350+ clients (CAC40, Fortune500) 

- 

$1M+ in profit generated for our clients since 2006 

- 

1,000+ data science projects 

Within Ekimetrics, the Innovation Department works on AI research topics in collaboration with our industrial and academic partners. The department comprises several PhD experts in generative AI, deep learning, computer vision, time series, explainability, and causality. Each expert leads teams tasked with studying and building state-of-the-art methods and adapting them to specific business problems, developing new methodologies or algorithms to address identified challenges, and ensuring a seamless handover for integration within Ekimetrics' industrial ecosystem. 

A central focus of the Innovation Department is closing the gap between cutting-edge AI agents and the day-to-day reality of delivering data science at scale. The department is investing in agentic systems that accelerate the data science lifecycle while keeping data scientists firmly in control of quality, governance, and business relevance. This internship sits at the heart of that effort, combining applied AI research with production-grade engineering on Ekimetrics' modern data stack. 

Internship Objective: From Latent Reasoning to Better and More Understandable Tabular Models 

Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) such as TabPFN, TabICL or TabDPT are transformers pre-trained on large collections of mostly synthetic datasets. They learn in context: the training data and the points to predict are given as input, and predictions come out of a single forward pass, with no dataset-specific training or tuning. They now rival gradient boosting on many benchmarks [3], which is changing how tabular modeling is practiced. 

In large language models, a growing line of research lets the model “reason” in its latent space rather than through generated tokens, using extra depth-wise computation, reused continuous hidden states or internal iterations. This latent reasoning can improve performance without longer text outputs [1, 2]. Our hypothesis is that a similar mechanism can improve TFMs: spending more latent compute at inference on hard or ambiguous cases could help them make better use of the in-context examples. Almost all existing work on latent reasoning targets natural language, and its transfer to tabular models, whose architecture, pre-training data and output differ profoundly, remains largely unexplored. 

Mechanistic interpretability is starting to open the black box, both for latent-reasoning language models and for TFMs themselves [4]. It lets us ask not only whether latent reasoning improves a TFM, but also what the model actually computes during these extra steps, and whether that computation is faithful and useful. The internship therefore has two goals: designing and evaluating latent reasoning mechanisms for TFMs, and using interpretability methods to analyze what they learn. 

The intern will work with senior researchers and data scientists. This internship offers an opportunity to contribute to an emerging research topic at the intersection of tabular modeling, latent reasoning and interpretability. 

Key Responsibilities 

The intern will: 

- 

Review the literature on latent reasoning (NLP) and tabular foundation models, building on recent surveys. 

- 

Identify and adapt latent reasoning mechanisms to TFM architectures (e.g. iterative depth-wise computation, hidden-state reuse). 

- 

Implement them on open-source TFMs and measure their effect on accuracy, calibration and robustness against strong baselines (gradient boosting, standard TFMs) at comparable compute. 

- 

Apply interpretability methods (representation analysis, probing, activation patching) to characterize the computation performed during latent reasoning. 

- 

Build an evaluation protocol on diverse tabular datasets, including realistic business cases. 

- 

Document the results and contribute to scientific publications. 

Profile 

- 

Currently in the final year of a Master’s or Engineering degree, with strong foundations in machine learning, statistics, and programming. 

- 

Good grasp of model validation: train/test splits, data leakage, baselines. 

- 

Strong analytical skills and the ability to work autonomously on an open-ended research problem. 

- 

Knowledge of transformers and language models; familiarity with latent reasoning or recurrent-depth models is a plus. 

- 

Strong Python and PyTorch skills, and a solid command of the standard data science toolkit (pandas/polars, scikit-learn, gradient-boosting libraries). 

- 

Fluency in English is a plus. 

- 

Nice to have: experience in interpretability, knowledge of TabPFN, TabICL or TabDPT, and solid software engineering practices (git, code review, testing). 

Benefits 

- 

Hands-on Research & Engineering Experience: Build a pioneering agentic system on real data science workflows, contributing to a tool with direct real-world impact. 

- 

Collaborative Learning: Engage with a team of data scientists, AI experts, and PhDs in a dynamic, research-driven environment within Ekimetrics' Innovation Department. 

- 

Skill Development: Gain expertise in LLM agents, the evaluation of AI systems, and production tooling on Databricks (Unity Catalog, MLflow). 

- 

Career Growth: Opportunity to transition into a full-time Data Scientist role in AI at Ekimetrics, or into a PhD program, upon successful completion of the internship. 

- 

Scientific Contribution: Opportunity to co-author and publish scientific papers in reputable AI and data science conferences and journals. 

- 

Networking: Collaborate with Ekimetrics' industrial and academic partners, enhancing your professional network in the AI research community. 

- 

Ethical and Sustainable AI: Learn to develop AI solutions that align with ethical, governed, and sustainable best practices, a core commitment of Ekimetrics. 

Duration: 6 months, Paris 

References 

[1] Zhu, R.-J. et al. (2025). A Survey on Latent Reasoning. arXiv:2507.06203. 

[2] Chen, X. et al. (2025). Reasoning Beyond Language: A Comprehensive Survey on Latent Chain-of-Thought Reasoning. arXiv:2505.16782. 

[3] Tabular Foundation Models: A Systematic Survey. [authors, year, link to complete] 

[4] Biloš, M. et al. (2026). A Mechanistic Study of Tabular Foundation Models. [link to complete]

Ekimetrics is a global leader in data science and AI-powered solutions. For 17 years, we have pioneered the use of AI and advanced data science applied to unified marketing measurement, holistic business optimization and broad-ranging sustainability goals.
We help companies rethink the way they operate, so they can reconcile financial KPIs with non-financial goals, like brand strength, customer lifetime value and operational effectiveness.
Ekimetrics is an independent firm with offices in Paris, London, New York City and Hong Kong. Since 2006, we have led more than 1,000 data science projects in over 50 countries, generating more than €1bn in profit for clients. We are working in a wide variety of industries (Luxury, Retail, Financial Services, Automotive, Property Development, FMCG, etc) with Fortune 500 companies.
At Ekimetrics, we believe our best assets are our people. They are what set us apart and drive our success.
We are an entrepreneurial spirit and innovation. We share what we know with others, and above all, we love our values-driven attitude: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Transmission, and Pleasure.
To accelerate our business growth in the APAC region, we decided to open a new office in Shanghai (operational since January 2024).
 About The Role 
As a data team associate, you will support the data team in daily data collection, collation and cleaning, ensuring data accuracy and completeness. You will work alongside the core data team on routine tasks and ad-hoc data-related assignments.
The primary focus of your work will be to assist in building reliable data foundations: this includes participating in data report creation/updates, supporting data visualization (e.g., Excel charts, basic BI tool use), and aiding in data research & analysis—summarizing findings into preliminary reports to inform business decisions.
You will also help maintain data documentation: classifying and filing data materials to standardize data assets. Additionally, you will support the upskilling of junior peers (where applicable) by sharing basic data processing practices.
The successful candidate will be expected to drive consistency in data workflows, transfer basic data management knowledge to team members as needed, and contribute to strengthening Ekimetrics’ data operational standards in Asia.
Date Support & Management: 
Assist the data team in daily data collection, collation and cleaning to ensure data accuracy and completeness
Participate in data report creation/updates, and support data visualization tasks (e.g., Excel charts, basic BI tool use)
Aid in data research & analysis, summarize findings into preliminary reports to inform business decisions
Help maintain data documents: classify and file data materials to standardize data assets
Team Collaboration: 
Cooperate with the team to complete other temporary data-related tasks
 About You 
The successful candidate will have a balance of basic data processing skills, logical thinking, and a proactive attitude. The work will be rooted in supporting reliable data operations for the team and business.
Ideally, you will have:
Bachelor’s degree or above; majors in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Management, Economics or related fields are preferred
Basic data processing proficiency, with strong command of Microsoft Excel (including VLOOKUP, Pivot Table, etc.)
Data-sensitive, with clear logical thinking, plus solid basic data analysis and problem-solving capabilities
Strong learning agility, proactive mindset, sense of responsibility, and excellent communication, coordination skills & team spirit
Preferred Qualifications:
Basic knowledge of SQL query statements
Familiarity with Python (Pandas, Numpy)
Prior data-related internship or project experience
 What We Offer 
Clear career growth path and professional skill training, with exposure to data work in real business scenarios
Flexible working atmosphere, with patient guidance from team members and full respect for interns' ideas
Opportunity to convert to a full-time employee
Strong culture and work environment
In 2023, Ekimetrics obtained the mission-driven company status, which demonstrates our strong commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). Our mission statement: Accelerate organizations transformation towards sustainability, through the application of data science and artificial intelligence.
We are also Great Place to Work certified© in France, the UK, and the US, and received the “Best companies to Work for in Asia 2023©” award in Hong Kong.
